column1: # Held-out test turns written by a person: none yet. This file is empty on purpose.
# Every test turn in this repository was written by the AI assistant: dev-turns.tsv while
# building, and stress-turns.tsv after the rule was frozen (git tag frozen-v1).
# A set written by a person who has not seen the prompt or the wording check is still needed.
# When it exists it goes here, and is run once with no tuning:
# One turn per line:    question number | what you meant | the turn, as you would say it
#   question number   1 to 5, as in interview/data-engineer.json
#   what you meant    answer     you are answering the question
#                     question   you are asking the interviewer something
#                     thinking   you are thinking aloud and have not finished
#                     unsure     honestly ambiguous, even to you: TurnCheck should ask
#   For a question you may add a fourth part: the sheet entry it should get, or none.
# Example (this line starts with # so it is ignored):
# 3 | question | wait, is snowflake the one with more joins | none
# Write them the way you would really say them in an interview: half sentences, fillers,
# questions that do not sound like questions. Question marks are removed before reading.
# About 30 turns is enough: roughly 10 answers, 10 questions, 5 thinking and 5 unsure.
